subject: physical-education
unitTitle: Leadership Capstone: Facilitating an Inclusive Activity
title: Unit assessment: gathering feedback that is actually useful under transfer
focus: gathering feedback that is actually useful
essentialQuestion: Can I run something that other people leave better than they arrived?
privacySafeScenario: Design, deliver, and evaluate one inclusive activity session for a real group, or deliver it for one participant with a complete plan if a group is not available, and revise the design from feedback.
studentTask: Learner works gathering feedback that is actually useful facilitated live for a real group, adapted in the moment when the plan meets reality, and evaluated on inclusion at a self-set intensity, then records what held, what degraded first, and how this occasion differed from the earlier one.
knowledgeCheck: In one concise response, say which feature of gathering feedback that is actually useful degraded first under the added demand, why, and what you would change before the next attempt.
completionCriteria: The learner holds gathering feedback that is actually useful facilitated live for a real group, adapted in the moment when the plan meets reality, and evaluated on inclusion, in whatever version their body and setting allow.
The learner names what degraded first and why, rather than reporting only whether it worked.
The learner compares this occasion with the earlier one and says what actually changed.
adaptationChoices: Group size is never a requirement; a session delivered to one person with a complete plan meets the standard fully.
extensionChallenge: Design the next progression of gathering feedback that is actually useful yourself, or coach the transfer condition to someone else so that they succeed with it — without completing another learner's graded work.
accessibilitySupports: Provide readable text plus optional audio or read-aloud support; no voice feature is required.
Chunk directions into one action at a time and show a worked example or model.
Allow typed, handwritten, spoken, drawn, demonstrated, or described responses when the standard permits.
Offer reduced-copying, extended-time, hidden-timer, rest-break, and low-distraction options.
Use captions, alt text, high-contrast print, keyboard access, and text-only fallbacks for media.
Preserve the learning target while adjusting quantity, pacing, intensity, range, equipment, or response mode.
Every movement task has a seated, supported, reduced-range, reduced-pace, and solo version that reaches the same standard.
Group size is never a requirement; a session delivered to one person with a complete plan meets the standard fully.

optionalReflection.prompt: Invite the learner to notice where gathering feedback that is actually useful shows up outside the session under real conditions. No purchase, account creation, photograph, recording, or public performance is required.

neverRequires: This task never requires body weight, height, BMI, or body-fat percentage.
This task never requires calorie counting or a diet or weight-loss goal.
This task never requires disclosing private medical history, a diagnosis, or sexual history.
This task never requires a photograph, video, or voice recording of the learner as proof.
This task never requires a public performance or an audience.
